files.tests/test_discount.py:
import tempfile
from shop.discount import discount

def test_discount_100():
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    assert discount(100, d) == 0

def test_discount_200():
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    assert discount(200, d) == 10
